_about: Residue names minimal.* drops on purpose. One list for every reader:
cpptraj_gmx_traj_manipulation.py strips water + ions (+ lipids) by these names;
mdr-process's output check 'solute' (mdrepo-rs#108) fails a minimal that lacks
any other residue full has. Names are compared without case by mdr-process.
water/ions/lipids: KNOWN_WATER, KNOWN_IONS, KNOWN_LIPIDS in the conversion script.
gromacs_water: what GROMACS's residuetypes.dat calls Water; the GROMACS path
keeps its 'non-Water' group, so these go too, though the script never names them.
Bound metals (Zn2+, Ca2+, ...) are NOT here: they stay in minimal (review #8).
From 2025-10-14 to 2026-04-29 the GROMACS path also dropped MOL (a ligand):
simulation-processing#30. Do not add a ligand name here.
